confirmed_issues.finding: HTTP observations discarded simulation timestamps and responses were not bound to observations.
confirmed_issues.resolution: protocol v2 carries and checks timestamps, rejects repeats, and validates reset acknowledgment

confirmed_issues.finding: Full training accepted optimizer/inference smoke without physical target-robot execution.
confirmed_issues.resolution: campaign revalidates raw closed-loop evidence, checkpoint, normalizer, binary and source identity

confirmed_issues.finding: run_trial unconditionally labeled injected mock backends as real PhysX.
confirmed_issues.resolution: synthetic backends produce nonphysical evidence rejected by physical readers

confirmed_issues.finding: policy interruption could bypass direct-loop safe stop; execution/perception traces were only written after terminal completion.
confirmed_issues.resolution: safe stop covers interruptions and reset failures; traces flush every tick

confirmed_issues.finding: backend commands rejected before any physics tick could appear as applied in execution traces.
confirmed_issues.resolution: no-time-advance rejection has null applied_action and an intervention reason

confirmed_issues.finding: checkpoint validation accepted arbitrary model types containing gr00t.
confirmed_issues.resolution: only N1.7 model identity and pinned NEW_EMBODIMENT projector index 10 are admitted

confirmed_issues.finding: Resolving a virtual-environment executable symlink bypasses its environment.
confirmed_issues.resolution: smoke executable paths retain virtual-environment symlinks; regression checks this

confirmed_issues.finding: TorchCodec reader library paths could break system FFmpeg and overwrite inherited driver paths.
confirmed_issues.resolution: system exporter strips private PyAV bridges and isolated reader paths preserve driver search directories

confirmed_issues.finding: No reusable compiled physical action-chunk boundary was available to the isolated policy client and server.
confirmed_issues.resolution: C++20 C ABI validates complete chunks in both runtimes, with binary identity in receipts

confirmed_issues.finding: A failed final physical attempt could prevent retry without deleting evidence.
confirmed_issues.resolution: each retry gets a preserved attempt directory and an updated stable gate receipt

confirmed_issues.finding: Pinned GR00T finishes with trainer.save_model(), which does not save trainer_state.json at the final run root. Fresh G3 smoke handed that root to a physical gate requiring TrainerState.
confirmed_issues.resolution: Fresh and resumed smoke both infer and transfer from the exact validated checkpoint-2; the real upstream trainer and synthetic fresh/resume regressions verify the handoff.

unverified_compatibility_risks: Full checkpoint load, bfloat16 inference, CUDA/FlashAttention/DeepSpeed execution and A-to-B optimizer/save/reload remain unexecuted here.
Actual camera freshness guard, renderer synchronization, native action boundary and articulation tracking must be validated together in pinned Isaac Lab/PhysX.
Simultaneous GR00T inference and RTX-rendered PhysX memory consumption is unmeasured; worker rechecks capacity after policy loading.
Closed-loop smoke verifies integration and measured movement even when tasks fail; M0 requires 50 frozen held-out scenes and counterfactual instructions.
A-to-B transfer and pretraining-overlap fairness require the scope v1.7 matched experiments; none are demonstrated by synthetic tests.

blockers.reason: 4 GiB GPU is below the repository training and camera-simulation memory gates; available RAM and audited output-volume reserve also fail.
Local GR00T interpreter has CPU-only torch and lacks DeepSpeed, FlashAttention and CUDA 12.8 compiler.
Located model metadata has no complete local safetensors weights; no validated trained checkpoint was found or downloaded.
Located LeRobot export is synthetic and correctly rejected; fresh physical pilot and leakage/provenance checks are required.
Common-revision expert qualification and event registration/attribution evidence cannot be inferred from legacy claims.
No paid provisioning, rental quote, spending cap or cloud approval was performed; use only an already approved host.

local pinned model weights and backbone; offline Hugging Face mode
fresh physical A/B training exports with disjoint held-out scenes
